DEVELOPER INTERFACE

Local API

BotConnector starts llama-server on loopback. OpenAI-compatible endpoints are provided by llama.cpp.

Chat Completions

POST http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1/chat/completions
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "local-model",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}],
  "stream": true
}

Runtime behavior

Bind address
127.0.0.1
Default port
11435
Tool calls
Requires compatible template; app starts server with --jinja
Multimodal
Requires model + mmproj when applicable
Embeddings
Runtime started with --embeddings

Anthropic Messages (native)

POST http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1/messages
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "local-model",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]
}

Responses API (native)

POST http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1/responses
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "local-model",
  "input": "Hello",
  "max_output_tokens": 256
}

Embeddings (embedding model only)

POST http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "local-embed",
  "input": ["first sentence", "second sentence"]
}

Access token

Public repositories do not require a token.

LOCAL API

Require authentication

No token configured.

When enabled, the runtime starts with --api-key and clients must send Authorization: Bearer. The token is encrypted with Windows safeStorage and shown only once. LAN serving stays disabled; bind remains 127.0.0.1.
